method: initialize + tools/list (anonymous, no tool called; roadmap#992)

tools.name: search
tools.title: Search fours.com
tools.description: Search the Fours website (fours.com, formerly suger.io) for pages about cloud marketplace go-to-market: AWS/Azure/Google Cloud marketplace listing, co-sell, private offers, agreements, billing & metering, and customer stories. Returns ranked pages with title, URL, type, and description.

tools.name: fetch_page
tools.title: Fetch a fours.com page
tools.description: Fetch the clean Markdown content of a single Fours website page, given a URL or path returned by `search` (e.g. "/platform/cosell/" or the full https URL).

path.description: A fours.com URL or path, e.g. /platform/cosell/
